note-geometry.label: Moving a node never reroutes an edge.

terminal-session.label:
$ diagram-spike move --id api --dy 30
applied: api moved, edges unchanged
$ diagram-spike describe
api -> cache "lookup"
$ diagram-spike render > path.svg
$ git commit -m "Add session cache"
$ git push
terminal-session.description: The author edits named objects, reads the semantic view, and commits the source.
